name: hqplayer-studio
description: HQPlayer Studio — a third-party modern music library, playlist manager and web remote for HQPlayer Desktop 6. Not affiliated with Signalyst.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n core,desktop,remote -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @hqps/core dev" "pnpm --filter @hqps/desktop dev:web" "pnpm --filter @hqps/remote dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hqps/remote build && pnpm --filter @hqps/desktop build && pnpm --filter @hqps/hqp-probe build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
